name: Divided Highway Begins
spec: yellow diamond with two black arrows splitting around a black island
meaning: The road ahead becomes a divided highway; keep right of the median.

snippets.back: A Divided Highway Begins sign warns that a center strip will separate the two directions of traffic ahead.
A divided highway begins sign tells you to stay right as the road divides, while a divided highway ends sign warns that two-way traffic will no longer be separated by a center island.
A Divided Highway Begins sign warns of a median separating two one-way roadways and directs drivers to keep right.
Divided Highway Begins warns of a median or divider separating one-way traffic lanes and directs drivers to keep right.
Divided Highway Begins or Ends signs mark the start or end of a divided highway, where you keep to the right.
DIVIDED HIGHWAY BEGINS warns of separated opposing one-way roadways ahead and instructs traffic to keep right of the median or divider.
Further warning signs pictured are Divided Highway Begins, Divided Highway Ends, Lane Ends, Merging Traffic, Added Lane and Traffic Signal Ahead.
Divided Highway Begins means the road splits into two one-way roadways, while Divided Highway Ends means two-way traffic resumes; keep right in both cases.
